title: An in vitro assay to quantify satellite cell activation using isolated mouse myofibers
protocol: Euthanize mouse in line with institutional regulations.
Disinfect the hindlimbs with 70% EtOH.
Open the skin of one of the hindlegs to expose the lower leg muscles.
Remove the fascia covering the TA muscle from knee to ankle using fine-tip forceps.
Free the TA/EDL muscles from the bone.
Insert fine-tip forceps behind the ankle-tendons of both the EDL and TA muscles.
Move the forceps up and down from knee to ankle to liberate the EDL/TA muscles from the tibial bone.
Liberate the TA muscle from the EDL.
Insert the fine tip forceps between the EDL and TA ankle tendons.
Lift up the TA muscle with the forceps and move them up towards the knee.
Expose the proximal EDL and fibularis longus tendons by removing tissue around the patella.
Insert the fine tip forceps behind the proximal EDL and fibularis longus tendons.
Cut the proximal EDL tendon using a scalpel blade.
Remove the TA muscle.
Cut the TA distal tendon near the ankle.
Lift the TA at the distal tendon.
Cut the TA proximal to the knee to remove it completely.
Carefully lift the EDL muscle at the proximal tendon.
Prevent stretching of the EDL during handling.
Remove the EDL by cutting its distal (ankle) tendon as close to the tendon as possible.
Place the EDL into a 1.5 mL tube.
Add 1 mL of prewarmed Col II solution to the tube.
Shake at 500 rpm and 37°C for 1.5 hours in an Eppendorf Thermomixer.
Repeat steps 3–7 for the remaining EDL.
Work fast to prevent excessive cooling of the EDL.
Avoid damaging the EDL when liberating the muscles.
Avoid stretching the EDL when removing it from the animal.
Prepare 3 × 15 mL conical tubes for disinfecting and washing utensils.
Fill one tube with 70% EtOH, one with PBS, and one with HS.
Clean pipet tips by sequentially pipetting up/down in EtOH, PBS, and HS.
Cut ±2 mm from the top of a sterile 1 ml plastic pipet tip.
Polish the cut pipet tip by carefully passing it through a flame.
Cutting and polishing pipet tips.
Prepare fiber purification setup with slide warmer, dissecting microscope, and sequential dishes containing fiber medium.
Release myofibers by pipetting EDL up/down using a P1000 pipette.
Aspirate and eject the EDL along the length axis in a smooth motion.
Move smaller EDL parts through the pipette tip along the length axis.
Liberate myofibers from digested EDL muscle using the method shown in video S1 on a slide warmer.
Release individual myofibers from digested EDL fragments as demonstrated in video S2 and perform this step on a slide warmer.
Place dish back in the 37°C incubator after working with it for maximally 10 minutes.
Allow the dish to recover for at least 15 minutes after handling.
Perform steps 10a-f from the method details for EDL2 in a new dish (dish 2-1).
While myofibers released from EDL2 are recovering, repeat steps 10f-g for the previous dish.
Alternate between dish #1-1 and #2-1 until no more fibers release.
Place dish #1-1 (with fibers) under the dissection microscope.
Place empty dish #1-2 on the slide warmer with warm fiber selection medium.
Curtail a 200 μL tip.
Flame-polish the cut tip to smoothen any sharp edges.
Optional: Clean pipette tip through EtOH, PBS, and HS.
Repeat cleaning for each new pipette tip.
Transfer transparent, elongated, straight myofibers from dish #1-1 to dish #1-2 using a P200 pipette.
Avoid contracted and opaque fibers during transfer.
Avoid transferring fiber fragments.
Avoid transferring adipose tissue.
Continue selecting myofibers for up to 10 minutes.
Return the dishes to the 37°C incubator after selection.
Leave the dishes for at least 15 minutes to recover.
Repeat step-by-step method details for transferring myofibers from dish #1-2 to dish #1-3 under dissecting microscope when dish #1-1 contains no more intact myofibers.
Transfer myofibers from dish #2-2 to dish #2-3 under dissecting microscope when dish #2-1 is empty.
Move viable myofibers from dishes #1-3 and #2-3 to dishes #1-4 and #2-4 containing experiment base medium when no more viable myofibers are detected in dishes #1-3 and #2-3.
Continue transferring fibers to dish #1-4 until no more viable myofibers are detected in dish #1-3.
Transfer fibers from dish #2-3 to dish #2-4 until no more viable myofibers are detected in dish #2-3.
Introduce a fifth dish (dishes #1-5 and #2-5) with experiment base medium for extra purification if necessary when yield is high (>250 myofibers from 2 EDL muscles).
Place the 96-well plate prepared before in an incubator at 37°C for at least 15 min to warm.
Place the 96-well plate on slide warmer.
Select a single viable myofiber in 50 μL experiment base medium from dish #1-4 (EDL1) or #2-4 (EDL2), and transfer to a 96-well containing 50 μL experiment medium.
Prepare a 2× concentrated solution for treatments in 96-well plates.
Dilute treatments automatically by adding myofiber medium to the appropriate concentration.
Avoid transferring debris with the myofibers during transfer.
Pick the next myofiber and allocate it to the well containing the next treatment.
Add a single myofiber to the first well of each treatment before moving to the second well per treatment.
Wait 10 minutes after adding fibers to the wells.
Return the 96-well plate and fiber-containing dish to the incubator.
Incubate the myofibers in the respective treatments for desired times.
Observe myofiber-derived colonies within 72 hours after start incubation.
Pre-warm 8% PFA (v/v) at 37°C.
Place 96-well experiment dish with cultured fibers on slide warmer.
Add 100 μl of prewarmed 8% PFA (v/v) to each well and incubate for 15 min.
Aspirate PFA solution from the wells.
Replace PFA with PBS.
Rinse wells thoroughly with PBS to remove all PFA.
Permeabilize cells with 0.5% Triton in PBA for 30 min at 18°C–22°C.
Block the sample with 20% HS (v/v) for 30 min.
Incubate with anti-PAX7 primary antibody (1 in 100 in PBA-Tw) for 1 hour at 18°C–22°C.
Rinse once with PBS-Tw.
Incubate with anti-KI67 primary antibody (1 in 100 in PBA-Tw) and biotinylated anti-mouse IgG (1 in 250 in PBA-Tw) for 1 hour at 18°C–22°C.
Rinse once with PBA-Tw.
Incubate with Streptavidin-AF647 (1 in 500 in PBA-Tw) and goat anti-rabbit AF488 (1 in 500 in PBA-Tw) for 1 hour at 18°C–22°C.
Rinse once with PBS-Tw.
Incubate with Hoechst (at 1 μg/mL in PBS) for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Rinse once with PBS-Tw.
Add 100 μl PBS/well to keep cells moist.
Image immunostained cells as soon as possible, but at least within one week after finishing immunostaining.
